examples.english: If you only look at the surface, you may not be able to tell what kind of person they are.
examples.traditional: 淨係睇外表，未必睇得出佢係咩人。

examples.english: His outside appearance seems cold, but he is actually very kind.
examples.traditional: 佢外表睇落好冷漠，其實係好好人。
